steps.en: Notices with existing particulars are shown and marked
steps.id: Notice dengan data lama ditampilkan dan ditandai
steps.why_en: The marker guesses from the processing stage, not from the saved particulars.
steps.why_id: Penanda hanya menebak dari tahap proses, bukan dari data tersimpan.

steps.en: Officer ticks the notices to update
steps.id: Officer mencentang notice yang akan diupdate

steps.en: Batch Furnish is offered only to users allowed to use it
steps.id: Batch Furnish hanya ditawarkan ke user yang berhak

steps.en: Officer picks owner, hirer or driver for all notices
steps.id: Officer memilih owner, hirer atau driver untuk semua notice

steps.en: One set of details is applied to every chosen notice in one go
steps.id: Satu set data diterapkan ke semua notice terpilih sekaligus

steps.en: Notices that already have details are overwritten too
steps.id: Notice yang sudah punya data juga ditimpa

steps.en: Notices that cannot be updated are rejected with a reason
steps.id: Notice yang tidak bisa diupdate ditolak beserta alasannya
